s: hakAraH । sa tu vyaYjanatrayastriMSavarRaH । azwama vargIyacaturTavarRaSca । tasya uccAraRasTAnaM kaRWaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA ca SikzAyAm । 17 । “kaRWyA vahAvicuyaSAstAlavyA ozWajAvupU ॥ *) asya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “hakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! caturvvargapradAyakam । kuRqalIdvayasaMyuktaM raktavidyullatopamam । rajaHsattvatamoyuktaM paYcadevamayaM sadA । paYcaprARAtmakaM varRaM triSaktisahitaM sadA । tribindusahitaM varRaM hfdi BAvaya pArvvati ! ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ * ॥ (vaNgIyavarRamAlAyAm) asya leKanaprakAro yaTA, -- “UrdDvAdAkuYcitA maDye kuRqalItvaM gatA tvaDaH । UrdDvaM gatA punaH sEva tAsu brahmAdayaH kramAt । mAtrA ca pArvvatI jYeyA DyAnamasya pracakzyate ॥ karIzaBUzitANgIYca sAwwahAsAM digambarAm । asTimAlyAmazwaBujAM varadAmambujekzaRAm ॥ nAgendrahAraBUzAQyAM jawAmukuwamaRqitAm । sarvvasidDipradAM nityAM DarmmakAmArTamokzadAm ॥ evaM DyAtvA hakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ asya nAmAni yaTA, -- “haH Sivo gaganaM haMso nAgaloko'mbikApatiH । nakulISo jagatprARaH prAReSaH kapilAmalaH ॥ paramAtmAtmajo jIvo yavAkaH SAntido'NganaH mfgA Bayo'ruRA sTARuH krUwakUpavirAvaRaH ॥ lakzmIrmmaviharaH SamBuH prARaSaktirlalAwajaH । svakopavAraRaH SUlI cEtanyaM pAdapUraRaH । mahAlakzmIH paraM SamBuH SAKoWaH somamaRqalaH ॥” iti varRABiDAnam ॥ * ॥ api ca । “SukraScATa hakAro'SaH prARaH sAntaH Sivo viyat । akulo nakulISaSca hasaH SUnyaYca hAkinI । ananto nakulI jIvaH paramAtmA lalAwajaH ॥” iti bIjavarRABiDAnam । api ca । “hakAro nakulISo'pi haMsaH prARo'NkuSaH priye । maheSo nakulI cEva varAvo gaganaM raviH । liNgaM SUnyo mahASUnyaH prARaSca parameSvari ! ॥” iti SrIrudrayAmale 8 pawale mantrABiDAnam ॥

m: 1. ह the thirty-third and last consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet (in Pāṇini's system belonging to the guttural class, and usually pronounced like the English h in hard; it is not an original letter, but is mostly derived from an older घ्, rarely from ध् or भ्).
2. ह m. (only L.) a form of Śiva or Bhairava (cf. नकुलीश)
a cipher (i.e. the arithmetical figure which symbolizes o)
calling, calling to the sound of a lute

3. ह ind. (prob. orig. identical with 2. घ, and used as a particle for emphasizing a preceding word, esp. if it begins a sentence closely connected with another; very frequent in the Brāhmaṇas and Sūtras, and often translatable by) indeed, assuredly, verily, of course, then &c. (often with other particles, e.g. with त्व् एव, उ, स्म, वै &c.; न ह, ‘not indeed’; also with interrogatives and relatives, e.g. यद् ध, ‘when indeed’; कद् ध, ‘what then?’ sometimes with impf. or pf. [cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 116]; in later language very commonly used as a mere expletive, esp. at the end of a verse), RV.; &c.
4. ह mf(आ)n. (fr. √ हन्) killing, destroying, removing (only ifc.; see अराति-, वृत्र-, शत्रुह &c.)
5. ह mf(आ)n. (fr. √ 3. हा) abandoning, deserting, avoiding (ifc.; see अन्-ओक- and वापी-ह)
a: ह — ind. An emphatic particle used to lay stress on the preceding word and translateable by ‘verily’, ‘indeed’, ‘certainly’, &c.; but it is often used expletively without any particular signification, especially in Vedic literature; तस्य ह शतं जाया बभूवुः; तस्य ह पर्वतनारदौ गृह ऊषतुः &c. Ait. Br. It is sometimes used as a vocative particle and rarely of disdain or laughter. --हः 1 A form of Śiva. --2 Water. --3 Sky. --4 Blood. --5 A cipher. --6 Meditation. --7 Auspiciousness. --8 Paradise. --9 Heaven. --10 Drying. --11 Fear. --12 Knowledge. --13 The moon. --14 N. of Viṣṇu. --15 War, battle. --16 A horse. --17 Pride. --18 Horripilation. --19 A physician. --20 Cause, motive. --हं 1 The Supreme Spirit. --2 Pleasure, delight. --3 A weapon. --4 The sparkling of a gem. --5 The sound of a lute (--m. also according to some in these senses).
